name: ATK_HOMEPAGE_OBJECTS
description: atk_homepage_objects : this table stores the meta data of each fuse card.

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Object Code: unique code based on LBA Prefix.

columns.name: FUSE_CARD_CODE
columns.description: FUSE_CARD_CODE: reference to ATK_FUSE_CARDS.FUSE_CARD_CODE

columns.name: IMAGE_PATH
columns.description:
Image Path: path to ACR image to use for Icon display for tabs.
Means image is supposed to be available in fusionapps/jlib/AdfAcrImagesPublicUi.jar

columns.name: LABEL_LOOKUP_TYPE
columns.description: LABEL_LOOKUP_TYPE: reference to FND_STANDARD_LOOKUP_TYPES.LOOKUP_TYPE based on the seeded lookup type for tab (VIEW_APPLICATION_ID = 0 and SET_ID = 0).

columns.name: LABEL_LOOKUP_CODE
columns.description: Label Lookup Code: reference to FND_LOOKUP_VALUES.LOOKUP_CODE . Product teams to seed lookup code with lookup type (VIEW_APPLICATION_ID = 0 and SET_ID = 0). The translated lookup meaning is shown for tabs in the ui.

columns.name: TASKFLOW_ID
columns.description: TaskFlow Id: The task flow for this object drilldown for object

columns.name: TASKFLOW_INPUT_PARAMLIST
columns.description: Parameters list to pass in to the task flow. This is a semicolon delimited String of name value pairs. For example, "param1=value1;param2=value2"

columns.name: FUSE_COMMON_OBJECT
columns.description:
FUSE_COMMON_OBJECT: resembles whether the task flow is a common task flow available in all containers. 
Set "N"  if it is not a common task flow available in all containers
Set "Y"  if it is a common task flow available in all containers
Defalut value is 'N'

columns.name: REMOTE
columns.description:
Remote Flag: Indicates whether the TaskFlow in local or remote
Set "N"  if it is local task flow from jar included in home page app
Set "Y" if it is remote task flow invocation against different app

columns.name: WEBAPP_MODULE
columns.description: Topology Module Key for the UI App that contains the task flow  This is used for determining the end point. Reference to ASK_MODULES.MODULE_NAME

columns.name: SECURITY_STRIPE
columns.description: Indicates the security policy stripe for the owning application. Valid values are fscm, hcm, crm. Default Value is fscm

columns.name: ENABLED
columns.description: Enabled: indicates if the object is enabled or not to show it to the user

columns.name: SEQUENCE
columns.description: Sequence: this will be used for icons ordering

columns.name: CAN_BE_HIDDEN
columns.description: CAN_BE_HIDDEN: Indicates whether this object can be hidden through customization or not

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
